about: Every official game image pingalto shows (owner 2026-11-10: official images from the publisher's own source, unmodified, with the publisher's notice; if a publisher objects, its art is removed). One switch per publisher: set publishers.<id>.enabled to false, rebuild and deploy the site, and sync the pingalto feeds (the clash feed then empties /data/feeds/clash-art/). Files of a set live in its dir (hashed into /s/ by the build) or, for art copied on the server, are listed by the feed in the document it names. robots.txt of each host is read before any download; a 403 is never worked around.

riot.notice: pingalto was created under Riot Games' "Legal Jibber Jabber" policy using assets owned by Riot Games. Riot Games does not endorse or sponsor this project.
riot.policy: brand-policies.json publishers.riot (Legal Jibber Jabber: noncommercial community use of Riot IP; no Riot logos)

supercell.notice: This material is unofficial and is not endorsed by Supercell. For more information see Supercell's Fan Content Policy: www.supercell.com/fan-content-policy.
supercell.policy: brand-policies.json publishers.supercell (Fan Content Policy: fan pages and guide apps; Supercell assets not modified)

sets.what: Square portrait of every League of Legends champion (Data Dragon, the version of the saved champion list)
sets.robots: ddragon.leagueoflegends.com/robots.txt answers 403 (an S3 error page): no rules, RFC 9309

sets.what: Card art of every Clash Royale card and its evolution, as named by iconUrls in the official API
sets.server: /data/feeds/clash-art/ on pingalto.com, written by the clash feed (tools/feeds/pingalto/card-art.mjs)
sets.robots: api-assets.clashroyale.com/robots.txt answers 404: no rules; the feed reads it before each new download
sets.list: /data/feeds/clash-art.json: every copied file with its source URL and the date it was copied

notAvailable.brawl-stars: The official Brawl Stars API (/v1/brawlers, /v1/events/rotation) names no images: brawlers and maps stay text.
notAvailable.valorant: Riot publishes no open image files for agents or maps (Data Dragon covers League of Legends only; valorant-api.com is not Riot).
notAvailable.valve: Valve publishes no fan-site licence; no Valve image (brand-policies.json).
notAvailable.epic: fortnite.com and epicgames.com answer 403 to us: not fetched (brand-policies.json).
notAvailable.logos: Riot forbids its logos without a written licence; the Supercell fan kit answers 403 to us; Garena and EA have no fan policy: no game logos.
